decisions.reason: The charting bundle is part of the map.apps ecosystem and costs little to maintain, but it no longer appeared on the website in 2020 to 2021, which suggests lower visibility.
The hierarchical search bundle is a niche plugin that has not been visible since 2018, but it can stay in the map.apps bundle catalogue at minimal cost.
VueTOC was an experimental mobile component that has disappeared from view, and its functionality is likely absorbed into newer responsive map.apps releases, so resources are better spent elsewhere.
The GIS solution platform is the firm's flagship and strategic focus, and withdrawing it would undermine the core business.
Field data capture remains a core need for utility and public customers, though competing platform offerings from major partners raise the risk of replacement.
